text: このまま　らくに　すすめると　おもうな！

structure.jp: このまま　らくに　すすめると
structure.en: that you can keep going easily like this

patterns.name: 〜と思う
patterns.span: すすめると　おもう
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up the thought that is being thought. すすめると　おもう = 'think that you can go on'.

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a rough order not to do it. おもうな = 'don't think'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing すすむ to すすめる adds the meaning 'can'. すすめる = 'can go on'.
